description.value: Mugshots is a neighbourhood cafe in Fernie, BC, serving all-day breakfast, lunch, quality coffee, fresh baked goods, and sweet treats from its cabinet. The cafe also offers catering services and a rentable event space, making it a versatile stop in a busy outdoor-recreation hub. Fernie is a major destination for mountain biking and backcountry travel, and this cafe serves both locals and passing visitors.
